title: Sections over the point commute with scalar extension
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\neq p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql$, and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. For finite extensions $E\subset L$ of $\Ql$ in $\Qlb$ write $R_F=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,s}$ for the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], for $F=E,L$. For $K\in D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] put $T_{L/E}K=K\widehat\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L$, meaning the strict-tower integral scalar extension of [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], which belongs to $D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_L)$ by [lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-constructible]. Let $\Gamma(s,-)$ be sections over the final object of $s_{\mathrm{proet}}$, applied termwise and passed to derived categories [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact]. There are isomorphisms in $D(\mathcal O_L)$, natural in $K$,
$$
 \varphi_{L/E,K}:\Gamma(s,T_{L/E}K)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(s,K)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L.
$$
Here tensor on module complexes is termwise ordinary tensor. The isomorphism is the inverse of the composite of the canonical sections-tensor map with sections of the canonical completion comparison $\chi_{L/E,K}:K\otimes^L_{R_E}R_L\xrightarrow{\sim}T_{L/E}K$ [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]; explicitly, if $\theta_{L/E,K}:\Gamma(s,K)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L\to\Gamma(s,K\otimes^L_{R_E}R_L)$ is induced by tensoring sections, then $\varphi_{L/E,K}=(\Gamma(s,\chi_{L/E,K})\circ\theta_{L/E,K})^{-1}$.

For $L=E$ this is the identity under the multiplication and completeness identifications $T_{E/E}K\cong K$. For $E\subset L\subset M$, let $a^{\mathrm{int}}_{M,L,E,K}:T_{M/L}T_{L/E}K\xrightarrow{\sim}T_{M/E}K$ be the integral associator obtained by conjugating the ordinary derived-tensor associator $(K\otimes^L_{R_E}R_L)\otimes^L_{R_L}R_M\cong K\otimes^L_{R_E}R_M$ by the canonical comparisons $\chi$. Write $a^{\mathrm{mod}}$ for the module-complex associator $(N\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L)\otimes_{\mathcal O_L}\mathcal O_M\cong N\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_M$. Then
$$
 \varphi_{M/E,K}\circ\Gamma(s,a^{\mathrm{int}}_{M,L,E,K})
 =a^{\mathrm{mod}}\circ(\varphi_{L/E,K}\otimes_{\mathcal O_L}\mathcal O_M)\circ\varphi_{M/L,T_{L/E}K}.
$$
Tensoring with $L$ over $\mathcal O_L$ gives natural isomorphisms
$$
 \Gamma(s,T_{L/E}K)\otimes_{\mathcal O_L}L\cong
 (\Gamma(s,K)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E)\otimes_E L
$$
in $D(L)$, with the same identity and composition compatibilities.

proof.text: The canonical ordinary sections comparison is the map already constructed in pointSectionsTensor. Its unit equation follows by evaluating on 1 tensor x: the module multiplication and sheaf multiplication both give x. Its tower equation follows on 1 tensor (1 tensor x): both balanced associators multiply the two constant coefficient factors. Double scalar-extension adjunction detects equality of module maps. Apply the exact-derived unit and tower descent lemmas of the coefficient-complex rationalization node, and conjugate by the counit-normalized pointOrdinaryDerivedComparison. Naturality of these comparison isomorphisms gives the corresponding equations for pointDerivedSectionsTensor, pointDerivedTensorUnit and pointDerivedTensorAssoc.

proof.text: Let psi be pointDerivedSectionsTensor followed by sections of completedScalarComparison. This is a natural transformation on the ambient derived category. On constructible complete objects the comparison is invertible by the finite-free completed scalar comparison. Therefore the specified phi=psi inverse is natural, by multiplying the naturality equation by the two inverse components.

proof.text: Unfold the specified integral unit and associator. The unit equation is the ordinary derived sections unit equation preceded by sections of chi inverse. For a tower, constructibility of the first extension allows its completion comparison to be inverted. Cancel the final chi with its inverse, apply the ordinary derived sections tower equation, and use naturality of pointDerivedSectionsTensor inverse along chi inverse. This gives exactly the integral associator equation without a choice of alternative associator.

proof.text: The auxiliary declarations for the canonical ordinary comparison are proved directly. Finite constant sections over the final point are their coefficient ring; the profinite tower identifies completed sections with the valuation ring. Evaluation of sheafification at the final point is unchanged, and transport across the two coefficient ring equivalences gives the balanced tensor comparison, its naturality and uniqueness. This avoids constructing a common global basis for this auxiliary comparison.

proof.text: Exact point sections and exact coefficient module tensors provide exactness. The already proved ordinary exactness clauses of the completed-scalar-extension t-exactness node give exact ordinary sheaf extension, so its finite-biproduct proof need not be repeated here. Its exact-derived comparison is normalized by the original universal counit. The ordinary unit is obtained from the complex multiplication at degree zero. The ordinary sheaf associator is the uniqueness comparison between composed left adjoints; the adjunction units insert tensor factors 1, and scalar linearity gives the full balanced formula and uniqueness. Module unit, module associator and rationalization are the uniquely normalized coefficient-complex constructions. Constructibility is transferred by the existing legacy equivalence; an auxiliary characteristic distinct from l transfers derived completeness to the unrestricted interface, so the completed comparison is invertible.
